question: Why is right knowledge the sole cause of liberation?
premises: Right knowledge abides in relation to both self and other.
The divisions of self, other, and so on are mere conceptual constructions.
Liberation depends on seeing through those constructions.
inference: Because bondage rests on conceptual divisions, right knowledge alone is sufficient for liberation.
plain_english: Right knowledge is the sole cause of liberation, whether in relation to self or other, because the divisions of self, other, and so on are nothing more than conceptual constructions.
